behavior: `Menu.Input` names in `aria-controls` only the id that the `Menu.List` element has now. It follows the id that the `#render` slot gives the list, and each later change of that id. It has no `aria-controls` while no list is mounted, while `KeepAlive` holds the list, and while the list element has an empty `id`. When an older list unmounts after a newer list mounts, the input names the newer list. In a menu with no filter, the active trigger follows the `id` of the `Menu.List` element in the same way. Base UI gives the input the default id of the list while no list is mounted, and after an older list unmounts beside a newer list. For a `render` function that gives the list another id, Base UI names the id that it gave to the function. No element has those ids. The trigger of Base UI reads the `id` of the list element when the trigger renders, so after a new id from the `render` prop of the list it names the old id until it renders again.
